prompt:
Locked-off camera, framing holds. The masked man in the pinstripe suit performs beside the dozing worker: his raised gloved hand pumps up and down on a steady head-nod groove, fingers held up as they are, while his other hand pats his knee on each beat, his head and shoulders bobbing along. The worker sleeps on, swaying gently with the tram. Sunlight bars slide slowly across the seats. The mask and fedora keep their exact shape. Audio: tram wheels clacking on rails, a soft bell, creaking wood; no voices.

Thanks.
